spec.name: concept-owed-rulings
spec.intent: A note may block a concept as well as a plan or unit. A live note blocking a concept is an owed ruling that refuses binding any plan, and adding any unit, whose realized concepts' closure contains that concept; it never takes an already-authored unit off the frontier. A concept is named for the blocks flag bare by its anchor where the anchor is its own (no plan or unit holds that name), else qualified as 'concept <anchor>'; the views print it qualified. Refusals name the note and the concept.
accept: a live note blocking concept c refuses 'plan bind' of a plan realizing a concept whose closure contains c, naming the note and c; the same bind succeeds once the note is retracted or revised to block nothing
a live note blocking concept c refuses 'plan add' of a unit realizing a concept whose closure contains c; a unit authored before the note stays ready and on the frontier
a note blocking a concept outside a plan's closure neither refuses binding it nor adding to it

the blocks flag resolves a bare anchor held by no plan or unit, and 'concept <anchor>' always; an unknown name is refused naming all three kinds; note show and plan show print the concept as 'concept <anchor>' among owed rulings
pnpm --filter @cratylus/runtime test and typecheck green; biome check clean on the unit's outputs
